title: New System.Text.Json JSON Patch Implementation
description: Use the new built-in JSON Patch support in System.Text.Json to apply partial updates to your API models.

data.text: .NET 10 introduces a new, high-performance JSON Patch implementation directly in System.Text.Json. Previously, applying partial updates required third-party libraries like JsonPatchDocument from Microsoft.AspNetCore.JsonPatch. The new implementation is faster, allocation-light, and works uniformly across Minimal APIs and controllers.

The new API uses the JsonPatch class from System.Text.Json. You can apply a patch document to an existing instance, producing a new instance with only the specified changes applied. This is especially useful for PATCH endpoints where clients send only the fields that need updating.

data.title: Apply a JSON Patch to a Product model in a Minimal API
data.content: Accept and apply a JSON Patch document to update a product

data.text: A JSON Patch document is a JSON array of operation objects. Each operation has an op field (add, remove, replace, move, copy, test) and a path field identifying the target property. The new System.Text.Json implementation supports all standard RFC 6902 operations.

data.content: A PATCH request body that updates a product's price and name

data.text: In controller-based APIs, accept the patch document as a parameter and apply it to the model retrieved from the database. Always validate the model after applying the patch and handle errors from invalid operations.

data.title: Benefits of the New Implementation
items: Built into System.Text.Json — no extra NuGet packages required.
Consistent API across Minimal APIs and controllers.
High performance with reduced allocations compared to the old Microsoft.AspNetCore.JsonPatch.
Full RFC 6902 compliance for add, remove, replace, move, copy, and test operations.

data.title: Summary
points: Use JsonPatchDocument<T> to accept partial updates in PATCH endpoints.
Apply the patch to the retrieved model instance with ApplyTo.
Validate the model after patching to catch invalid operation targets.
The new System.Text.Json implementation is the recommended approach going forward.
data.takeaway: The new System.Text.Json JSON Patch implementation simplifies partial updates and removes the dependency on the legacy Microsoft.AspNetCore.JsonPatch package.
